description: Move a booking to an open slot. The client is not emailed. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant.

confirm.description: Set true only after the caller has seen a preview and wants it done. Anything else, including the string "true", is a preview and changes nothing.

new_start.description: New start, ISO 8601. Must be an open slot for this booking's length.

name: reschedule_booking
title: Reschedule a booking
